verification.blenderInterchange: generated/world-v5/interchange-verification.json: world-v5-r1 BLEND/FBX/GLB passed; 325264 triangles, 29 meshes, 14 unchanged anchors. Local boulder intersection cleanup preserves all remaining vertex positions and colors; ground texture hashes unchanged.
verification.characterRoundTrip: generated/character-v5/frozen-export-verification.json: FBX/GLB passed, 53956 triangles, 62 renderers including 28 skinned meshes, 4 armatures / 12 bones. Native Blender rig; 144 evaluated sole poses checked separately in gait-verification.json.
verification.purePuzzleRules: independently checked by gameplay implementation agent
verification.windowsRuntime: verification/run-015-v6/runtime-results.json: all functional checks passed; real movement 2.293m, cabin/boulder collision and walkway grounding verified. Two actual Unity-skinned soles: 220 idle-pose ground samples, minimum clearance 0.001385m. 1440x900 Iris Xe short samples: menu 60, overview 60, walking 57.9, portrait 60 FPS; final-view 55.7. No builds or Blender rendering during the tour. Idle sole samples do not verify every moving pose.
verification.webRuntime: verification/web-005-v6/runtime-results.json: real-keyboard completion, reload persistence, walking, ending return and default audio policy passed. Foreground 1440x900 Iris Xe interval-FPS medians: menu 49.09, ending 53.15, walking 34.63. No captured browser exceptions; hidden-shader, INVALID_ENUM and sound-loading engine diagnostics remain. Rolling averages include earlier views and are not current-view measurements.
verification.finalVisualComparison: verification/visual-review.html uses final run-015-v6 native captures, original reference images, and v5/run-013-v5 comparison. Shallow crowned stepping stones, foreground boulders and subtle leaf gradients add depth; intersecting plants and hard moss patches were corrected. Character skin, fabric folds and rock detail remain simpler than the reference. Static images do not establish gait quality; the overall aesthetic objective is not yet achieved.
verification.shaderChecks: verification/v6-integration-checks.json; tinted FoliagePaint compiled, all 29 imported island meshes retain vertex colors, 27 renderers are in static batches. Actual GPU evidence: verification/web-v6-gpu-profile/. About 1030 draws/frame versus v5 about 1116; no clear walking FPS gain. Different speed, endpoint, world and rig prevent attributing the entire change to batching.
